set -u
printf "%s
" "kumitate-shokunin 83016d45 scripts/kimi-census.mjs" "kagi-shokunin 275d8294 corpus/surface-census.sh" "tsukuroi-shokunin 084951be tools/tsukuroi-census.sh" "mado-shokunin d7edaab4 tools/mado-verify.sh" "kagi-shokunin 7e5ec98b corpus/checklist-run.sh" "kumitate-shokunin e9a21b44 scripts/claims-check.mjs" | while read -r repo rev path; do R=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/$repo; if full=$(git -C "$R" rev-parse --verify "$rev^{commit}" 2>/dev/null); then blob=$(git -C "$R" show "$rev:$path" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$blob" ]; then echo "$repo $rev -> $full | $path | MISSING"; else s=$(printf "%s
